title.tagline: Party chaos for 2-8 friends on one laptop
title.hint: Arrows + ENTER to choose   |   ESC = back

join.title: WHO'S PLAYING?
join.need2: Need 2+ players (press + to add a bot)
join.ghost: Ghosting test: everyone hold your keys. Unlit key = keyboard can't handle that combo, try a gamepad.

free.title: FREE PICK
free.hint: Pick any mini-game to practise. ESC = back

sumo.name: Belly Bump Sumo
sumo.desc: Your arrow spins. Press to DASH. Bump everyone out of the ring!

quickdraw.name: Wait For It...
quickdraw.desc: Slam your button when it says GO! Too early = OOPS. Watch for fakes!

noodle.name: Tangled Noodles
noodle.desc: Steer your noodle. Don't crash into any noodle or the wall!

sack.name: Balap Karung
sack.desc: Sack race! Press your two keys one after the other (A, B, A, B) to hop. Same key twice = faceplant!

kerupuk.name: Makan Kerupuk
kerupuk.desc: Hands behind your back! Bite your swinging cracker when it's right at your mouth. Miss = CHOMP air.

potato.name: Hot Potato Bomb
potato.desc: Got the bomb? Throw it LEFT or RIGHT before it goes BOOM. Last one standing wins!

colorsnap.name: Colour Snap
colorsnap.desc: Press ONLY when the big blob shows YOUR colour and shape. Gold star = everyone! Wrong press = -1.

tug.name: Tarik Tambang
tug.desc: Tug of war, two teams! Mash to pull. Pull on the drum beat for DOUBLE power.

sweeper.name: Spin Sweeper
sweeper.desc: A giant beam spins around. Press to JUMP over it. Get swept = out!

hoops.name: Floppy Hoops
hoops.desc: Press to jump toward the ball. Holding it? Press again in the air to SHOOT. Best at the top of your jump!
